remediationChecklist.goal: Deploy or identify the remote staging websiteResolverServiceV1 endpoint.

remediationChecklist.goal: Provision resolver token through a secret manager or protected environment variable.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_TOKEN is set without exposing the raw token in repo files, logs, traces, or reports.

remediationChecklist.goal: Lock CORS to the approved NetSuite staging origin.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_ALLOWED_ORIGIN and IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_BLOCKED_ORIGIN are configured and W73R proves approved pass / blocked fail behavior.

remediationChecklist.goal: Run approved live-site smoke through the hosted endpoint.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: Approved live smoke passes with zero false-confident-wrong and zero unsupported claims.

remediationChecklist.goal: Run W73R and full preflight after remote config is present.
remediationChecklist.doneWhen: W73R trace shows remoteSmokeExecuted true and preflight remains green.

Keep drawer and SuiteScript write-disabled, preserve N/LLM advisory-only, notes story-only, and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout as insufficient evidence with no confident guesses. Output remediation pack, operator checklist, updated trace samples, W75 report, validator gates, and best next Codex prompt.
